n11e87528dbf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Green India Mission?
o: It was launched in 2011 as one of the eight missions under the NAPCC
Its sub-missions cover forest quality, forest cover and livelihoods
It is linked to an additional carbon sink of 2.5-3.0 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent by 2030
It targets 10 million hectares of new forest cover
n11e87528dbf.x: GIM targets 5 mha of new forest cover plus 5 mha of quality improvement, not 10 mha of new cover. The other three statements are correct.

n5b6af99e174.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Forest Rights Act, 2006?
o: It recognises the habitat rights of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups
Under it, the Gram Sabha recommends diversion of forest land only for commercial mining
It gives ownership rights over minor forest produce
n5b6af99e174.x: Under FRA the Gram Sabha recommends diversion of forest land for public utilities, not commercial mining. PVTG habitat rights, MFP ownership and nistar rights are all recognised.

n22b579e98bf.s:
Assertion (A): After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh received only about 46% of Central Generating Station power though it had about 58% of the population.
Reason (R): Central Generating Station power was divided on the basis of the last five years' consumption.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n22b579e98bf.x: CGS power was split by the last five years' consumption, not by population, which is why AP got about 46% despite having about 58% of the population.

nf46746b977a.s: According to the 2011 Census, the population of residual Andhra Pradesh was about:
nf46746b977a.x: Residual Andhra Pradesh had 4.96 crore people and Telangana 3.52 crore; the APRA population ratio was 58.32:41.68.

nc5dbf30158f.s: Mangampet in YSR Kadapa district has India's largest deposit of:
nc5dbf30158f.x: Mangampet has India's largest barytes deposit; Tummalapalle (YSR Kadapa) is AP's uranium site and AP's bauxite is in Araku, Chintapalli and Paderu.

n0bca6abd8f6.s: Andhra Pradesh accounts for approximately what share of India's cultured-shrimp exports?
n0bca6abd8f6.x: AP accounts for about 75 per cent of India's cultured-shrimp exports and about 29 per cent of India's fish production.

nc84e7afbcb1.s: In Andhra Pradesh, tidal or mangrove forests occur mainly at:
o: The mouths of the Godavari and Krishna
nc84e7afbcb1.x: Mangrove (Coringa) forests occur near the Godavari and Krishna mouths; moist deciduous forests are in the north-coastal hills, dry deciduous in Kadapa-Kurnool and thorn-scrub in interior Rayalaseema.

n3d611c23aa0.s: As per ISFR 2021, Andhra Pradesh's Recorded Forest Area of 37,258 sq km ranked it ____ in India.
n3d611c23aa0.x: AP's Recorded Forest Area was 37,258 sq km and it ranked eighth in India, not fifth.

nd05936210d4.s: The National Forest Policy, 1988 envisages what forest cover for hilly areas?
nd05936210d4.x: The 1988 policy aims at 33% overall forest cover and 66% in the hills; AP has about 23.6% forest cover.

na24c5247029.s: The Red Sanders Protection Scheme covers Seshachalam, Veligonda, Lankamala, Talakona and ____ ranges.
na24c5247029.x: The scheme covers the five ranges Seshachalam, Veligonda, Lankamala, Nallamala and Talakona.

n7ee6500461f.s: The planned power-generation capacity of the Polavaram Project is:
n7ee6500461f.x: Polavaram is associated with 960 MW of generation, irrigation of 7.20 lakh acres and transfer of 80 TMC to the Krishna basin.

ndb7c8940218.s: Under Schedule XI of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, which use of water gets the highest priority?
ndb7c8940218.x: Schedule XI gives drinking water priority over irrigation and irrigation priority over power; tribunal allocations already made remain unchanged.

n1ea4b2ee49f.s: Under the 2014 ad hoc arrangement, KWDT-I's 811 TMC for undivided AP was shared between AP and Telangana as:
n1ea4b2ee49f.x: AP got 512 TMC and Telangana 299 TMC, about 66:34; the 58:42 population ratio was not used for Krishna water.

ne7d1843b736.s: The National Forest Policy that preceded PESA (1996) and the Forest Rights Act (2006) was issued in:
ne7d1843b736.x: The National Forest Policy was issued in 1988, followed by PESA in 1996, FRA in 2006 and APRA in 2014.

n98d36064bac.s: After the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh, coal resources went mainly to:
n98d36064bac.x: Coal went mainly to Telangana, while residual Andhra Pradesh retained important coastal and basin minerals.

n4c485bd2e31.s: Under the Twelfth Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act, existing SCCL coal linkages for AP thermal plants were:
n4c485bd2e31.x: Existing SCCL linkages were kept unchanged, and new linkages were to be provided under the Government of India's coal policy.

n1c868b2aa92.s: How many Nagar Vans were sanctioned to Andhra Pradesh under the Central Nagar Van Yojana?
n1c868b2aa92.x: The Central Nagar Van Yojana sanctioned 61 Nagar Vans; the State's Nagaravanam programme completed 37 city forests and seven Temple Eco-parks.

nf4b2f6729ed.s: For ISFR classification, forest cover means land with a tree canopy density of at least:
nf4b2f6729ed.x: Forest cover is land with canopy density of at least 10%, irrespective of legal ownership or notification status.

n3e82085058b.s: Which of the following did residual Andhra Pradesh lose after bifurcation?
n3e82085058b.x: AP retained the coast, the deltas and the Krishna-Godavari tail-end, but lost coal and the Hyderabad industrial base.

n70b2f65d127.s: Andhra Pradesh is predominantly covered by which type of forest?
n70b2f65d127.x: AP is mostly tropical dry deciduous forest and has 3 national parks, 13 wildlife sanctuaries and 1 tiger reserve.

n4588a705727.s: As per the 2023-24 remeasurement, the coastline of Andhra Pradesh is:
n4588a705727.x: The 2023-24 remeasurement gives 1,053.07 km, the third-longest after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu; 974 km is the older figure.

nbcbffec4ec2.s: Which region of Andhra Pradesh is largely rain-shadow and drought-prone?
nbcbffec4ec2.x: The Godavari, Krishna and Penna deltas are fertile coastal alluvium, while Rayalaseema is rain-shadow and drought-prone.

nd750301b82f.s: Which notified non-major port of Andhra Pradesh handles the most cargo?
nd750301b82f.x: Krishnapatnam handles the most cargo among the notified non-major ports; Visakhapatnam is the State's one major port.

n5146b91def3.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: no false fact in original)
n5146b91def3.s: Andhra Pradesh sought tax holidays for post-bifurcation industrialisation under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
n5146b91def3.x: AP's demands included tax holidays under Section 94(1) and backward-area packages under Section 46, besides revenue-deficit grants, Polavaram funding and capital-city grants.

n3ac4424878d.s:
Assertion (A): Under Special Category Status, the Centre would bear 90 percent of Centrally Sponsored Scheme costs.
Reason (R): Under the ordinary arrangement, the Centre bears only 60 percent of such costs.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3ac4424878d.x: Both are true: SCS gives a 90 percent central share and 60 percent is the ordinary arrangement. R is only a contrast and does not explain A.

ne6fde043f80.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
A. Enactment of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act
B. 14th Finance Commission raises States' share of the divisible pool from 32% to 42%
C. TDP leaves the NDA over the Special Category Status row
ne6fde043f80.x: APRA was enacted in 2014, the 14th FC award (raising devolution to 42%) applied from 2015, and the TDP left the NDA in 2018.

n8cbe6b3bfef.s: In FY25, the combined fiscal deficit of Indian States stood at about:
n8cbe6b3bfef.x: States' combined fiscal deficit was about 3.2% of GDP in FY25, and revenue balances worsened in 18 States between FY19 and FY25.

na208cc39fb7.s: The Fourteenth Finance Commission fixed a normative post-devolution revenue gap for Andhra Pradesh from:
na208cc39fb7.x: The 14th FC fixed a normative, static post-devolution gap from 2015-16; AP argued its actual deficits exceeded it.

n4a16fb859e0.s: Corporate taxes, stamp duties and ____ were important components of the Hyderabad region's revenue in the undivided State.
n4a16fb859e0.x: Corporate taxes, stamp duties and commercial taxes were key parts of Hyderabad's revenue contribution; agricultural land revenue was not its basis.

nb76509efdf1.s: As per Accounts at a Glance 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh's fiscal deficit, against an FRBM ceiling of 4%, was:
nb76509efdf1.x: AP recorded a fiscal deficit of 5.05% against the 4% ceiling and a revenue deficit of 3.75% against the 2.70% target.

n610856d327b.s:
Assertion (A): The Krishna and Godavari River Management Boards are autonomous bodies under the administrative control of the Centre.
Reason (R): Each Board has a full-time Member Secretary and one central expert.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n610856d327b.x: Under Sections 85(3) and 85(4), the Boards are autonomous bodies under Central control, each with a Central Chairperson, two members per State, a central expert and a full-time Member Secretary. R describes their composition, not why they are under Central control.

n9a91729cd98.s: Polavaram was declared a national project under which section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
n9a91729cd98.x: Section 90 of APRA declared Polavaram a national project; it is planned for 960 MW.

n9a172380906.s: Kaleshwaram, a subject of inter-State objections, is a Telangana project on which river?
n9a172380906.x: Kaleshwaram is Telangana's Godavari project; AP sought clearances for it while Telangana wants national-project status.

n82973e0609e.s: The Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal-II was chaired by:
n82973e0609e.x: KWDT-II was chaired by Justice Brijesh Kumar; its award came in 2010 with a further report in 2013.

nfb21198e20d.s: The Tungabhadra Board was set up under Section 66 of which Act?
nfb21198e20d.x: The Board was set up under Section 66 of the Andhra State Act, 1953; under Section 91(1) of APRA, AP and Telangana replaced undivided AP on it.

n3b854920a87.s: Who is the Chairperson of the Apex Council constituted under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
n3b854920a87.x: The three-member Apex Council is chaired by the Union Minister of Water Resources, with the CMs of AP and Telangana as members.

n06c4b22a41f.s: Telangana's demand for a 50:50 split of Krishna water rests on its:
n06c4b22a41f.x: Telangana's 50:50 demand rests on its larger basin area, not population; the 2014 ad hoc split gave AP 512 TMC and Telangana 299 TMC (66:34).

n5ca8ed43b13.s: The Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar Link envisages diversion of water:
o: From the Krishna through the Godavari to the Penna
From the Godavari through the Penna to the Krishna
From the Penna through the Krishna to the Godavari
From the Godavari through the Krishna to the Penna
n5ca8ed43b13.x: The link envisages diversion from the Godavari through the Krishna basin to the Penna basin.

n2f6145ffb30.s: In October 2023, the Centre gave KWDT-II further terms of reference under:
o: Section 5(1) of the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956
Section 89 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
Section 87 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
Section 3 of the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956
n2f6145ffb30.x: The October 2023 terms of reference were given under Section 5(1) of the ISRWD Act, 1956, not Section 89 of APRA alone.

n5ac8ab09075.s: The Ministry of Jal Shakti notified the jurisdiction of the KRMB and GRMB on:
n5ac8ab09075.x: Both Boards' jurisdiction was notified on 15 July 2021; under Section 87 the Boards have jurisdiction over projects notified by the Centre.

n89df7e8fe6a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Polavaram Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Section 90 declares Polavaram a national project
Under Section 90(3), the consent of Telangana is deemed to have been given
Under Section 90(4), the Government of Andhra Pradesh shall execute the project and obtain all clearances
In practice, AP executes the irrigation component on behalf of GoI and claims reimbursement
n89df7e8fe6a.x: Section 90(4) says the Central Government shall execute the project and obtain environmental, forest and R&R clearances, not the AP Government.

ndb99475332f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal?
o: Of the remaining 35 TMC, Karnataka gets 14 TMC and Maharashtra 21 TMC
It was set up in 1969 and gave its award in 1980
Its award cleared Polavaram with an FRL of +150 ft
Of the 80 TMC diverted into the Krishna above Vijayawada, AP gets 45 TMC
ndb99475332f.x: The remaining 35 TMC is split 21 TMC to Karnataka and 14 TMC to Maharashtra, not the reverse.

ncd90686d653.s:
Assertion (A): The Polavaram Project is designed to irrigate 7.20 lakh acres.
Reason (R): The gross reservoir capacity of Polavaram is 194.6 TMC.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncd90686d653.x: Both are true: Polavaram irrigates 7.20 lakh acres (2.91 lakh ha) and has 194.6 TMC gross capacity, but reservoir size alone does not explain the irrigation design.

n7bd583638b5.s: In December 2025, land acquisition and R&R for the Polavaram Project were only about ____ complete.
n7bd583638b5.x: LA and R&R stood at only 27.40% in December 2025, the main bottleneck; by August 2026 LA reached 94% and relocation 52%.

n3ce16b0c163.s: From 1 April 2014, the Centre funds 100 per cent of the remaining cost of which Polavaram component?
n3ce16b0c163.x: The Centre funds 100 per cent of the remaining irrigation-component cost; drinking-water and hydel components are not covered.

n01068b09602.s: Telangana's submergence concern about Polavaram relates to backwater at:
n01068b09602.x: Telangana's concern is backwater at Bhadrachalam, while Odisha and Chhattisgarh objected over protective embankments.

n0dad6854863.s: The proposed Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link was earlier known as the:
n0dad6854863.x: The Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link was earlier called the Banakacherla link; Telangana contends it violates APRA 2014 and the 1980 GWDT award.

n5c387ef4fe5.s: The office of the CEO of the Polavaram Project Authority is located in:
n5c387ef4fe5.x: The Authority, constituted after APRA 2014 with inter-State coordination functions, has its CEO in New Delhi.

n226d8b516f3.s: For the Polavaram Project, the value of a house site in R&R colonies was increased from Rs 1 lakh to:
n226d8b516f3.x: The house-site value was doubled to Rs 2 lakh; Rs 1,943 crore was paid in three phases under the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.

nfc74cacaa3c.s: The Polavaram proposal was named "Ramapada Sagaram" by:
nfc74cacaa3c.x: Sir Sonti Venkataramamurthy named the proposal Ramapada Sagaram; the project was first contemplated in 1941.

nfe5b8b7ec77.s: How many mandals were moved from Khammam to Andhra Pradesh under the Polavaram-related territorial arrangement?
nfe5b8b7ec77.x: Seven mandals were moved: Kukunoor, Velerupadu, VR Puram, Chintoor, Kunavaram, Bhadrachalam (except the temple town) and Burgampadu.

n2cc9d94414c.s: By August 2026, the civil works of the Polavaram Project were reported to be:
n2cc9d94414c.x: By August 2026, civil works were at 90% and overall progress at 77%.

ncf078cf4f1a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about irrigation debates in Andhra Pradesh?
o: HNSS, GNSS and Telugu Ganga are Krishna-lift projects that Rayalaseema depends on
These Rayalaseema lift projects often run dry
A key criticism is the gap between irrigation potential created and utilised
Telangana supports Andhra Pradesh's proposed Godavari links
ncf078cf4f1a.x: Telangana objects to AP's Godavari links, saying they violate APRA 2014 and the 1980 GWDT award.

nac4ebcd675a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sources of irrigation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Tanks were the largest source of Gross Irrigated Area in 2023-24
Tank irrigation is important because of undulating plateau relief and impervious rocks
Canals dominate irrigation in the Godavari-Krishna deltas
Wells and tube wells accounted for about 48% of GIA in 2023-24
nac4ebcd675a.x: Wells and tube wells were the largest source (about 48% of GIA) in 2023-24; tanks accounted for only about 8%.

n284626d21a0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about groundwater in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The stage of groundwater development is about 30%, in the safe category
The area irrigated per well is rising
About 40,000-50,000 new bore wells are added every year
n284626d21a0.x: With 40,000-50,000 new bore wells added each year, the area irrigated per well is falling, not rising.

nb4ba4e87817.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh ranked first nationally in micro-irrigation in 2024-25.
Reason (R): The micro-irrigation subsidy is 100% for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nb4ba4e87817.x: Both are true (AP ranked first in 2024-25 and SC/ST beneficiaries get 100% subsidy), but the subsidy for one group does not by itself explain the national ranking.

n571b6d6a180.s: Which of the following is a component of the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)?
n571b6d6a180.x: PMKSY's components are AIBP, Har Khet Ko Pani, Watershed and Per Drop More Crop; the others are Andhra Pradesh State programmes.

n6be1eae3c01.s: Under Per Drop More Crop, assistance to small and marginal farmers for drip and sprinkler systems is:
n6be1eae3c01.x: PDMC (from 2015-16, under RKVY since 2022-23) gives 55% to small and marginal farmers and 45% to others.

n3cdb3a50ebe.s: Andhra Pradesh has approximately how many bore wells?
n3cdb3a50ebe.x: AP has about 19 lakh bore wells, and groundwater is the largest source of its Gross Irrigated Area.

nc83f792d8d1.s: Construction of the Prakasam Barrage on the Krishna at Vijayawada began in:
nc83f792d8d1.x: Construction began in February 1954 under the Prakasam ministry; the barrage replaced Cotton's Krishna anicut of the 1850s.

n7f756db32ff.s: In Andhra Pradesh, minor irrigation covers schemes with an ayacut up to:
n7f756db32ff.x: In AP, minor irrigation means an ayacut up to 5,000 acres; nationally, minor means a CCA up to 2,000 ha.

nbb1b3a34c31.s: The nodal department for Neeru-Chettu in Andhra Pradesh is the:
nbb1b3a34c31.x: The Water Resources Department is nodal for Neeru-Chettu, launched on 2 October 2014 as a water-conservation sub-mission.

n346dec0e16a.s: Jalayagnam, launched during the Tenth Five Year Plan, was launched by:
n346dec0e16a.x: Jalayagnam was launched by Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy; N. Chandrababu Naidu is linked to Neeru-Meeru (2000).

nf654f83cbd8.s: Jawaharlal Nehru laid the foundation stone of the Nagarjuna Sagar project on:
nf654f83cbd8.x: Nehru laid the foundation stone on 10 December 1955, in the last months of the First Plan; the dam is on the Krishna.

n7940340c451.s: In 2023-24, canals accounted for approximately what share of Andhra Pradesh's Gross Irrigated Area?
n7940340c451.x: Canals accounted for about 40% of GIA, wells and tube wells about 48%, tanks about 8% and other sources about 3%.

n937ba83dda3.s: The Neeru-Meeru programme mainly focused on:
o: Rainwater harvesting and raising groundwater levels
n937ba83dda3.x: Neeru-Meeru was a watershed and rainwater-harvesting drive intended to raise groundwater levels.

n08a596ccf80.s: The Pattiseema lift irrigation scheme on the Godavari mainly benefits farmers of the:
n08a596ccf80.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water for Krishna delta farmers, as a temporary arrangement until Polavaram's gravity flow begins.

n7b8622a40fc.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched regarding institutional division after bifurcation?
o: Section 53 – Commercial undertakings by location, headquarters assets by population
Sheela Bhide Committee – Division of institutions and undertakings
Schedule X institutions – Mostly located in Hyderabad
n7b8622a40fc.x: Schedule IX covered 91 companies and corporations; the 142 institutions, mostly in Hyderabad, were under Schedule X.

nefa53873040.s: The backward-area programmes under Section 94 of the AP Reorganisation Act cover how many districts of residual AP?
nefa53873040.x: They cover seven districts (4 Rayalaseema + 3 North Coastal); new units there get 15% additional depreciation and 15% investment allowance.

n39232f8809e.s: The investment chill in Andhra Pradesh after 2014 arose mainly from:
o: Capital uncertainty and no ready administrative set-up
n39232f8809e.x: The chill came from capital uncertainty, no ready administrative set-up and agitations, not from any lack of coastline.

nb4ffced7be1.s: After bifurcation, residual Andhra Pradesh kept only a bulk-drug base at:
nb4ffced7be1.x: Genome Valley and the Hyderabad pharma belt went with Telangana; AP kept only a bulk-drug base at Visakhapatnam.

na2b52973599.s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 made Amaravati the sole capital by inserting:
na2b52973599.x: The 2026 Amendment inserted Section 5(3) making Amaravati the sole capital; Section 5 had made Hyderabad the common capital till 2024.

n4bb98692dd5.s: Just after bifurcation, manufacturing accounted for around what share of residual Andhra Pradesh's GSDP?
n4bb98692dd5.x: Manufacturing was about 10.5 percent of GSDP (not the whole industry sector), and the State was about 60 percent agriculture-dependent.

nd4cb1f99d4d.s: Which centres of IT exports did residual Andhra Pradesh lose after bifurcation?
o: Rushikonda IT Park and Kakinada SEZ
Tirupati electronics cluster and Sri City
HITEC City and the Financial District
nd4cb1f99d4d.x: The residual State lost Hyderabad's HITEC City and Financial District, important centres of IT and ITES exports.

nccf0f96fdb8.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh's Green Hydrogen Valley Declaration aims to make the State the "Green Hydrogen Capital".
Reason (R): Paradip, Kandla and Tuticorin, the National Green Hydrogen Mission hubs, are all in Andhra Pradesh.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nccf0f96fdb8.x: The Declaration (Amaravati, 19 July 2025) aims to make AP the Green Hydrogen Capital, but Paradip (Odisha), Kandla (Gujarat) and Tuticorin (Tamil Nadu) are outside AP.

nb45db9acbd2.s: How many hours of free daytime power do Andhra Pradesh's 22.36 lakh farm pump sets receive?
nb45db9acbd2.x: 22.36 lakh farm pump sets receive nine hours of free daytime power; aqua power is priced at Rs 1.50 per unit.

n72923266c96.s: The present Vijayawada-based APCPDCL was carved out of APSPDCL in:
n72923266c96.x: The new APCPDCL was carved out of APSPDCL in 2020; the pre-2014 APCPDCL was headquartered at Hyderabad.

n281fbc1af33.s: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, the Government of India was to examine establishing a major port at:
n281fbc1af33.x: The Act provided for examining a major port at Duggirajupatnam, a new railway zone and upgrades to the Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati airports.

n8f014fa5d72.s: The creation of South Coast Railway was promised in which Schedule of the A.P. Reorganisation Act, 2014?
n8f014fa5d72.x: South Coast Railway was promised in the Thirteenth Schedule and carved out of the South Central and East Coast Railways.

nf44d31ac434.s: South Coast Railway, India's 18th railway zone, is headquartered at:
nf44d31ac434.x: SCoR is headquartered at Visakhapatnam, with Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam divisions; it became operational on 1 June 2026.

n25024313e17.s: The wholly State-owned APIIC mainly focuses on:
n25024313e17.x: APIIC handles industrial infrastructure and land (parks, estates, SEZs, EMCs, land bank); industrial financing and promotion is APIDC's role.

n9852c66aeb8.s: APIIC can allot up to how many acres of land without Cabinet approval?
n9852c66aeb8.x: APIIC can allot up to 50 acres without Cabinet approval; after 1991 its role changed from manufacturer to facilitator.

nd4de880474e.s: In which year was APIIC incorporated?
nd4de880474e.x: APIIC was incorporated on 26 September 1973 and is wholly State-owned; APIDC was set up in 1960 for industrial financing and promotion.

nceb13ce3348.s: The AP Maritime Policy 2024-29 targets what share of all-India port cargo by 2047?
nceb13ce3348.x: The policy targets 20% of all-India port cargo by 2047 and at least one port in the world's top 20.

n7a199f45a0d.s: The equity of APGIC is held by APIIC and APGENCO in the ratio:
n7a199f45a0d.x: APGIC is 51% APIIC and 49% APGENCO; it was set up on 2 September 2009 and is a partner in a KG exploration consortium.

nb500bff88ae.s: The AP Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia Policy, 2023 was folded into which policy?
nb500bff88ae.x: The 2023 green hydrogen policy was absorbed into the AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024.

n72afe8cad81.s: The Kakinada-Konaseema region is known as Andhra Pradesh's:
n72afe8cad81.x: The Kakinada-Konaseema region is AP's oil and gas hub, associated with the KG basin.

nac53509031c.s:
Assertion (A): Most projects under Swadesh Darshan 1.0 have been completed.
Reason (R): Of the 76 projects sanctioned under Swadesh Darshan 1.0, 75 had been completed.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nac53509031c.x: Swadesh Darshan 1.0 (thematic circuits) had 76 sanctioned projects, of which 75 were completed, which is why A holds.

n0af79ec2910.s: Under the AP Tourism Policy 2024-29, tourism and hospitality have been accorded:
o: Industry status only for Mega projects
Industry status only for heritage hotels
n0af79ec2910.x: Tourism and hospitality got industry status across all segments, with fiscal, recurring, special and non-fiscal incentives and tailor-made packages for Mega and Ultra Mega projects.

n3bdc168b775.s: Which body is the fully State-owned operational arm of tourism in Andhra Pradesh, running Haritha hotels and the Srisailam ropeway?
n3bdc168b775.x: APTDC is the State-owned operational arm running Haritha hotels, boating, sound-and-light shows and the Srisailam ropeway; PRASHAD is a Union Ministry of Tourism scheme.

n83a59b68021.s: Swarna Andhra Tourism Vision 2047 was unveiled at the:
n83a59b68021.x: The vision was unveiled at the FAITH conclave; AP separately won the Best Tourism Promotion State award at GTM 2026.

ndd82659ea27.s: The AP Tourism Policy 2024-29 aims to place Andhra Pradesh among India's top ____ tourist destinations.
ndd82659ea27.x: The policy targets a top-three rank, with tourism above 20% of State GVA and 20% of the workforce.

n7500146bc47.s: Which of the following institutions is associated with the proposed education hub at Amaravati?
n7500146bc47.x: VIT, SRM and Amrita are associated with Amaravati; IIT Tirupati is not listed among the institutions hosted there.

nbc75d758c13.s: The Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), the medical-device hub, is located at:
nbc75d758c13.x: AMTZ is at Visakhapatnam; Amaravati has the 'Eye Tourism' zone, AIIMS Mangalagiri anchors eSanjeevani and IITTM Nellore trains hospitality staff.

n0c4ea84717d.s: Andhra Pradesh's proposed beach-shack policy is modelled on that of:
n0c4ea84717d.x: The beach-shack policy is modelled on Goa's; AP has also sought a shift of Vizag Beach Road from CRZ-3 to CRZ-2.

n7abfe782c2e.s: The AP Tourism Policy 2024-29 is aligned with which vision?
n7abfe782c2e.x: The policy is aligned with Swarna Andhra @2047, not Viksit Bharat @2047.

n9ec8babcbba.s: In Swadesh Darshan 2.0, the sub-scheme CBDD stands for:
n9ec8babcbba.x: CBDD is Challenge Based Destination Development, a sub-scheme of Swadesh Darshan 2.0; SASCI is Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment.

nde6540a6803.s: Andhra Pradesh is described as the birthplace of which form of Buddhism?
nde6540a6803.x: AP is described as the birthplace of Mahayana Buddhism and has about 40 Buddhist monuments.

n3f4116f89ac.s: How many projects were sanctioned nationally under Swadesh Darshan 2.0?
n3f4116f89ac.x: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 had 52 projects nationally, while PRASHAD had 54.

nf7d6e7f9fcb.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
nf7d6e7f9fcb.s: Amaravati Quantum Valley, described as India's first Quantum Valley, functions under the:
nf7d6e7f9fcb.x: Amaravati Quantum Valley works under the National Quantum Mission in quantum computing, QKD and post-quantum cryptography, with full stamp-duty and registration-fee exemption for eligible firms.

n8aa17636219.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
n8aa17636219.s: Andhra Pradesh's IT & GCC Policy 4.0 covers which period?
n8aa17636219.x: The IT & GCC Policy 4.0 is for 2024-29, with capital subsidies, tax exemptions, employment-linked incentives and a focus on AI, cloud and cyber technology.

n8cf5f21c001.s:
Assertion (A): AP's LIFT Policy 4.0 offers land incentives for GCCs and IT infrastructure developers.
Reason (R): AP's Data Center Policy 4.0 targets the addition of up to 1 GW of data-centre capacity.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8cf5f21c001.x: Both are true features of separate policies (LIFT: land incentives; Data Center Policy: up to 1 GW), so R does not explain A.

n96887a86811.s:
Assertion (A): MeeSeva was launched on 4 November 2011 as a single-window citizen service portal and centre network.
Reason (R): MeeSeva grew out of the APSWAN network offices of the 1990s.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n96887a86811.x: A is true, but MeeSeva grew out of the Naidu-era eSeva centres (2001), not APSWAN offices of the 1990s.

n60e54d5fddf.s: The foundation stone of Google's AI data centre in Andhra Pradesh was laid at:
n60e54d5fddf.x: The foundation stone was laid on 28 April 2026 at Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam; Kopparthy is an electronics cluster.

n73b67ed8908.s: The AP IT (Electronic Service Delivery) Rules, 2011 made which of the following mandatory for departments?
n73b67ed8908.x: The rules made electronic service delivery mandatory and gave legal sanctity to digitally signed certificates; they did not repeal the IT Act, 2000.

nd8ae37daedd.s: Andhra Pradesh's Data Center Policy 4.0 targets additional capacity of up to ____ during 2024-29.
nd8ae37daedd.x: AP targets up to 1 GW, lower than Gujarat's 7.5 GW target under its 2026-29 policy.

ndf308beb1bf.s: Which Andhra Pradesh initiative seeks to interconnect all e-governance systems through a whole-of-government approach?
ndf308beb1bf.x: e-Pragati interconnects departmental systems with a single window for Revenue, Registration, Transport and Municipal services, built on the Seva model.

n478b6b8e7da.s: The Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) of Andhra Pradesh has functioned since:
n478b6b8e7da.x: RTGS dates from 2017 and is the nodal agency for real-time monitoring, data analytics, AI and early warning.

n6d65abff283.s: The Konugolu e-auction portal of Andhra Pradesh came under:
n6d65abff283.x: Konugolu came under G.O.Ms. No. 16 of 27 September 2018, not the AP IT Rules of 2011; e-Procurement has run since 2002.

nc014afa0199.s: The AP IT & GCC Policy 4.0 (2024-29) came into force on:
nc014afa0199.x: The policy came into force on 12 December 2024 with the aim of making AP a global knowledge economy hub.

nb8ffd5d5be3.s: The custodian ministry of the Information Technology Act, 2000 is the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
nb8ffd5d5be3.x: MeitY is the custodian of the IT Act, 2000, which was last amended in 2008 and is the parent law of the AP e-Service Rules.

nb29c78553be.s: Under the Zone A/B incentive of the AP ESDM Policy, stamp duty, transfer duty and registration fee are reimbursed at:
nb29c78553be.x: The ESDM Policy 2021-24 reimburses 100 per cent of stamp duty, transfer duty and registration fee; income tax is not included.

n054f71470dd.s: Drone City, described as India's first dedicated drone cluster, is being established at:
n054f71470dd.x: Drone City is at Orvakal in Kurnool, covering 600 acres with 120 acres in Phase-I.

n98cf911e574.s: Mana Mitra (WhatsApp Governance) of Andhra Pradesh was launched on:
n98cf911e574.x: Mana Mitra was launched on 30 January 2025 under minister Nara Lokesh; the G.O.Ms. No.16 e-auction portal is Konugolu.

n1a7df28ec71.s: MEDHAS, built by NIC-AP, was developed for:
o: Dr NTR University of Health Sciences, Vijayawada
n1a7df28ec71.x: MEDHAS (Medical Education & Health Administrative System) was built for Dr NTR University of Health Sciences, Vijayawada.

nd8f17f27661.s: AP Technology Services Ltd (APTS), the nodal agency for IT procurement and cyber security, was set up in:
nd8f17f27661.x: APTS dates from 1986, is self-financing, and is the nodal body for IT procurement, cyber security, digital certificates and Aadhaar.

nb0fb3604f0d.s: AP Drone Policy 4.0 (2024-29) targets how many direct jobs?
nb0fb3604f0d.x: The policy targets 15,000 direct jobs (and 25,000 indirect), 100 drone companies, 50 skilling centres and 25,000 trained pilots.

nef470e3a16b.s: eSeva (2001), India's first integrated citizen service centres, was launched under Chief Minister:
nef470e3a16b.x: eSeva was launched in 2001 under N. Chandrababu Naidu, not Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy.

n628d7844428.s: In Andhra Pradesh, BharatNet Phase-II, implemented by APSFL, covers how many Gram Panchayats?
n628d7844428.x: APSFL implements BharatNet Phase-II covering 54,502 km and 11,254 Gram Panchayats.

n62cafefcb21.s: The AP Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 (2024-29) targets electronics production of:
n62cafefcb21.x: The policy targets production of US$50 bn and investment of US$10 bn.

n338d00da633.s: AP State FiberNet Ltd (APSFL), incorporated in October 2015, was launched on:
n338d00da633.x: APSFL was launched on 27 December 2017; the Phase-I Network Operations Centre is at Visakhapatnam.

n4daa25eb089.s: Andhra Pradesh's Electronics Components Manufacturing Policy, aimed at building a component ecosystem, was issued in:
n4daa25eb089.x: The 2025 policy aims at a component ecosystem, offering advance and matching incentives, interim support and plug-and-play facilities.

neefafaed9ba.s: The Kopparthy industrial cluster is located in which district?
neefafaed9ba.x: Kopparthy is in YSR Kadapa district, while Renigunta and Sri City are in Tirupati district.

n35878bf5f13.s: Which RTGS tool of Andhra Pradesh provides disaster early warning?
n35878bf5f13.x: AWARE 2.0 gives disaster early warning (used in cyclones Montha and Ditwa); AI4PGRS is grievance AI and DigiVerify issues blockchain certificates.

n584ef6d297a.s: Andhra Pradesh's Quantum Valley is located at:
n584ef6d297a.x: Quantum Valley is at Amaravati; Data & AI City is at Visakhapatnam, the Green Hydrogen cluster at Kakinada and Drone City at Orvakal.

n2263480985f.s: Village and Ward Secretariats were started in Andhra Pradesh in:
n2263480985f.x: Village and Ward Secretariats started in October 2019, after APSWAN (2010), MeeSeva (2011) and APSFL (2015).

n4008be2bc52.s:
Assertion (A): Mulching is practised under APCNF.
Reason (R): Crop-residue or straw cover conserves soil moisture and suppresses weeds.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4008be2bc52.x: APCNF uses mulching precisely because the residue or straw cover conserves moisture and suppresses weeds.

n2706b011c0b.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in oil-palm area.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh accounts for 48% of India's oil-palm area.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n2706b011c0b.x: AP holds 48% of India's oil-palm area (2.49 lakh ha), which is why it ranks first in area; it also leads in production and productivity.

n7335eb76822.s:
Assertion (A): Aquaculture is regarded as the core of Andhra Pradesh's Blue Economy.
Reason (R): AP's aquaculture markets are completely independent of foreign demand.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n7335eb76822.x: Aquaculture supports over five lakh families and is the Blue Economy's core, but it depends on foreign markets, including the US.

n466b408118f.s:
Assertion (A): Rayalaseema accounts for 71 per cent of the micro-irrigation coverage under APMIP.
Reason (R): APMIP has been in operation since 2003-04.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n466b408118f.x: Both are true (APMIP since 2003-04, 37.90 lakh acres, 13.49 lakh farmers, 71% in Rayalaseema), but its start year does not explain the regional concentration.

nb240d7017b0.s: Which of the following pairs regarding the Food Planet Prize 2026 is correctly matched?
nb240d7017b0.x: The prize carried US$1.5 million from the Curt Bergfors Foundation and was held at Bastad, Sweden, in June 2026; APCNF was the first Indian finalist.

nddadca065f2.s: Which of the following pairs regarding DBT of the free agricultural power subsidy in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Smart meters fitted on – Domestic connections
Stated target – 100% renewable energy for domestic consumers
nddadca065f2.x: The pilot was in Srikakulam (2020) with smart meters on farm pump-sets, and the target is 100% renewable energy for agricultural pump-sets.

na92c7832d32.s: Which of the following is a feature of Zero Budget Natural Farming?
na92c7832d32.x: ZBNF emphasises minimum tillage, livestock integration and crop diversity, and avoids chemicals.

nd4858771adc.s: Agriculture and allied activities contributed what share of Andhra Pradesh's GVA in 2025-26?
nd4858771adc.x: Agriculture and allied activities contributed 33% of GVA in 2025-26 and support about 60% of the population.

n618d9f1b68e.s: ATMA, the district-level extension agency, is a centrally sponsored initiative with a Centre:State funding pattern of:
n618d9f1b68e.x: ATMA runs on a 60:40 centrally sponsored pattern and prepares the Strategic Research and Extension Plan (SREP).

n23341e39d93.s: In 2023-24, per capita egg availability in India was about ____ eggs per year.
n23341e39d93.x: Per capita availability was 103 eggs a year; India was 2nd in world egg production with 142.77 billion eggs.

ne827d941c53.s: The crude palm oil target of the National Mission on Edible Oils-Oil Palm for 2025-26 is:
ne827d941c53.x: NMEO-OP (2021) targets 11.20 lakh t CPO by 2025-26; 28 lakh t is the 2029-30 target. It aims to add 6.5 lakh ha to reach 10 lakh ha.

n79664bf8a7f.s: Which of the following is a sub-scheme of the Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)?
o: National Mission on Edible Oils-Oil Palm
n79664bf8a7f.x: The National Horticulture Mission and the Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan States are sub-schemes of MIDH.

n9e12cf8a263.s: Andhra Pradesh, with horticulture GVA of Rs 1,52,950 crore, ranked third in India after:
n9e12cf8a263.x: AP ranked third after Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra, with 21% growth in horticulture GVA in 2024-25.

nd73f2845bf7.s: The PM-KISAN component of Annadata Sukhibhava-PM Kisan, meant for landholders, is:
nd73f2845bf7.x: The scheme (from 2024-25) includes the Rs 6,000 PM-KISAN component for landholders and also covers CCRC-holding tenant farmers.

na5870771d83.s: The Indo-Israel Centre of Excellence for vegetables in Andhra Pradesh is located at:
na5870771d83.x: Kuppam hosts the Indo-Israel vegetable centre; the new vegetables and spices centre is at Gundlapalli in Nekarikallu mandal, Palnadu.

na5bdf3a0a1f.s: Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS), the not-for-profit company under AP's Department of Agriculture, was incorporated in:
na5bdf3a0a1f.x: RySS was incorporated in October 2014; 2016 is the year ZBNF was launched in AP.

nfdc8a5171d9.s: As keyed in APPSC Group 2 (2025), Andhra Pradesh ranks ____ in India in mango production.
nfdc8a5171d9.x: AP is 2nd in mango production and 1st in oil palm productivity.

n79e32f80c54.s: The National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched in:
n79e32f80c54.x: The sequence is Oilseeds Technology Mission (1986), NMOOP (2014) and NMEO-OP (2021).

nc89011923d9.s: In 2023-24, milk production in Andhra Pradesh declined by:
nc89011923d9.x: Egg, meat and milk outputs all fell in 2023-24, with milk recording the largest decline of 9.41%.

ncf93288340e.s: In Andhra Pradesh, a Rythu Bazar is run by:
ncf93288340e.x: A Rythu Bazar is run by an Estate Officer, while a regulated yard is run by a Market Committee.

n5b559392dd4.s: Which of the following agro-climatic zones of Andhra Pradesh is wrongly matched with its zonal headquarters?
n5b559392dd4.x: The Godavari Zone's headquarters is at Maruteru, not Rajahmundry; the other three pairs are correct.

n911eee8965a.s:
Assertion (A): The Scarce Rainfall Zone of Andhra Pradesh has its headquarters at Nandyal.
Reason (R): The Krishna Zone of Andhra Pradesh has its headquarters at Maruteru.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n911eee8965a.x: Scarce Rainfall Zone is headquartered at Nandyal, but the Krishna Zone is at Lam (Guntur); Maruteru is the Godavari Zone HQ.

nd3192d4153b.s: Andhra Pradesh's agro-climatic zones continue to be listed against how many old districts?
nd3192d4153b.x: The zones remain listed against the 13 old districts and were not re-cut after the April 2022 reorganisation; AP now has 28 districts.

n2286da07ebd.s: Kurnool district belongs to which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh?
n2286da07ebd.x: Kurnool is in the Scarce Rainfall Zone; the Southern Zone covers Chittoor, YSR Kadapa and SPS Nellore.

na193f3045cb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 97th Constitutional Amendment?
o: It added Article 19(1)(c) on the right to form cooperatives
It inserted Article 43B as a Directive Principle
It added Part IXB on cooperative societies
The Supreme Court retained Part IXB in its entirety for State cooperatives
na193f3045cb.x: The Supreme Court struck down Part IXB for State cooperatives and kept it only for multi-State societies.

n055b963e71a.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
n055b963e71a.s: The world's largest grain storage programme in cooperatives envisages storage facilities at the level of:
n055b963e71a.x: The decentralised plan builds storage at the PACS level, supported through AIF, AMI and other schemes.

n633235a542f.s:
Assertion (A): The Cooperative Societies Act, 1912 allowed non-credit societies to be formed.
Reason (R): The National Cooperative Policy was announced in 2011.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n633235a542f.x: The 1912 Act did allow non-credit societies, but the National Cooperative Policy came in 2002; 2011 is the year of the 97th Amendment.

ndf0255a256c.s: Under the decentralised grain storage plan (Sep 2026), the AMI subsidy was raised from 25% to:
ndf0255a256c.x: The AMI subsidy rose to 33.33%, margin money was cut from 20% to 10%, and with 3% AIF subvention PACS pay about 1%.

nd55208495ea.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cooperative Tribunal is chaired by:
nd55208495ea.x: The Tribunal is chaired by a judicial officer, hears appeals under the 1964 Act and has original jurisdiction under the MACS Act, 1995.

n0436db5b6aa.s: PACS in how many blocks of Andhra Pradesh are eligible for NCDC equity grants as FPOs?
n0436db5b6aa.x: PACS in 207 blocks are eligible for NCDC equity grants as FPOs, with APCOB acting as the CBBO.

n41cad2668f2.s: According to APSES 2024-25, how many PACS are there in Andhra Pradesh?
n41cad2668f2.x: APSES 2024-25 gives 2,042 PACS, 13 DCCBs with 442 branches and 18 APCOB branches.

n509b233c637.s: Societies formed under the AP Mutually Aided Cooperative Societies Act, 1995 are:
o: Administered directly by the Cooperative Tribunal
n509b233c637.x: MACS Act societies are self-reliant, have no government share capital and are run by members with minimal State control.

naee08236890.s: Model bye-laws permit PACS to undertake more than how many non-credit activities?
naee08236890.x: Model bye-laws allow more than 25 non-credit activities, and ERP software covers about 80,000 PACS nationally.

nbdbac12be6d.s: In Andhra Pradesh's three-tier cooperative credit structure, the district-level tier is:
nbdbac12be6d.x: APCOB operates at the State level, DCCBs at the district level and PACS at the village level.

ne213dee09f5.s: How many PACS in Andhra Pradesh are being computerised under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
ne213dee09f5.x: 2,037 PACS are covered; 1,490 is the number assigned to fertilizer companies and 1,553 completed pre-migration.

n074c13a8d93.s: Which of the following NABARD funds is wrongly matched with its purpose?
o: LTIF – State share of ongoing PMKSY irrigation projects
Warehouse Infrastructure Fund – Rural infrastructure loans to States
n074c13a8d93.x: The Warehouse Infrastructure Fund supports scientific storage and APMC facilities; rural infrastructure loans to States come from RIDF.

n6c8823848c7.s: Which of the following is NOT an institutional source of agricultural finance for farmers in Andhra Pradesh?
n6c8823848c7.x: Commercial banks, RRBs and PACS are institutional sources; informal moneylenders are not.

n7ee1452a390.s: On its establishment, NABARD took over the whole of which body, besides RBI's ACD and RPCC?
o: Small Industries Development Bank of India
n7ee1452a390.x: NABARD took over RBI's Agricultural Credit Department and Rural Planning and Credit Cell and the whole of the ARDC.

nf52e4af4a2b.s: Since 2019, NABARD has been fully owned by:
nf52e4af4a2b.x: Since 2019 NABARD is fully owned by the Government of India; it is headquartered in Mumbai and started with Rs 100 crore.

n815b704ea8c.s: SHG members say they find it hard to scale up beyond linkage loans because they often lack:
n815b704ea8c.x: Members often lack individual CIBIL credit histories needed to scale up, and linkage loans are seen as too small for expansion.

nindian-economy-30-5.s: NABARD was established in 1982 on the recommendations of the:
nindian-economy-30-5.x: NABARD came in 1982 on the B. Sivaraman Committee's recommendations; SIDBI followed in 1990 and the Narasimham I report in 1991.

nindian-economy-59-21.s: The Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF), created in 1995-96, had an initial corpus of:
nindian-economy-59-21.x: RIDF began in 1995-96 with Rs 2,000 crore and is administered by NABARD; disinvestment proceeds go to the NIF, not RIDF.

nindian-economy-30-13.s: NABARD was established through the NABARD Act of:
nindian-economy-30-13.x: The NABARD Act was passed in 1981 and NABARD was set up in 1982, the same year as the EXIM Bank.

nindian-economy-30-14.s: Which committee's 1991 report began banking-sector reforms in India?
nindian-economy-30-14.x: The Narasimham Committee I (1991) launched banking reforms through its recommendations to admit new private banks and deregulate interest rates.

nd6271608faf.s: In Andhra Pradesh, long-term agricultural credit is mainly provided by:
nd6271608faf.x: ARDBs provide long-term credit, whereas the PACS-DCCB-SCB cooperative system mainly provides short-term credit.

n549865422bf.s: Andhra Pradesh's State Focus Paper for 2026-27 allocated how much to agriculture and allied activities?
n549865422bf.x: The plan allocated Rs 2.55 lakh crore to agriculture and allied activities and Rs 1.64 lakh crore to MSMEs.

nc4f824af739.s: District Potential Linked Credit Plans are aggregated into:
nc4f824af739.x: District PLPs are aggregated into NABARD's State Focus Paper, which then feeds the SLBC Annual Credit Plan.

n27ebe0f7871.s: Under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme, short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh are available to prompt repayers at:
n27ebe0f7871.x: Short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh are available at 4% for prompt repayers.

n3fb2859b6d3.s: In agricultural marketing, e-NAM has so far mainly helped in:
o: Fully enabling payments across all mandis
n3fb2859b6d3.x: e-NAM facilitates price discovery but is not yet fully operational for payments or inter-mandi trade.

n44e0233158b.shape: one-liner (single step asked instead of sequence)
n44e0233158b.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh framework, the first step in setting up a regulated market is:
n44e0233158b.x: The Government first declares a notified area, then constitutes a Market Committee, which establishes the notified market.

nfab250f23f4.s: After the three central farm laws were repealed in November 2021, the 1966 Agricultural Market Committee framework:
o: Was replaced by the Model APMC Act
nfab250f23f4.x: The 2020 farm laws were repealed in November 2021, but the 1966 AMC framework remained operative.

n2fe0eff5c15.s: The main post-harvest infrastructure gap identified in Andhra Pradesh is:
o: Limited operational storage and need for more cold storage
n2fe0eff5c15.x: The main gap is limited operational storage, along with the need for more cold-storage facilities.

n16eeab587a3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AP Single Desk Portal?
o: It requires physical visits to regulators for every clearance
It is a single Government-to-Business point for industrial clearances
It enables online application, payment, tracking and certificates
n16eeab587a3.x: The portal is designed to provide clearances without physical visits to regulators.

n21582d2fa6c.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
n21582d2fa6c.s: Andhra Pradesh's Industrial Development Policy (4.0), notified on 26 October 2024, was issued as:
n21582d2fa6c.x: IDP (4.0) is G.O.Ms.68; the MSME policy is G.O.69, Electronics Manufacturing G.O.70 and Food Processing G.O.71.

n89df49c7dd3.s: Which of the following MSME limits is NOT correct?
o: 2020: Micro – investment Rs 1 crore, turnover Rs 5 crore
2020: Small – investment Rs 10 crore, turnover Rs 100 crore
2020: Medium – investment Rs 50 crore, turnover Rs 250 crore
2025 revision: Small – investment Rs 25 crore, turnover Rs 100 crore
n89df49c7dd3.x: The 2020 small-enterprise turnover limit was Rs 50 crore; Rs 100 crore (with Rs 25 crore investment) is the revised 2025 limit.

n81a7e0bca1d.s:
Assertion (A): Women, SC/ST, BC and specially-abled entrepreneurs receive preferential access under Andhra Pradesh's MSME policy.
Reason (R): The additional 5 per cent capital subsidy is restricted exclusively to women entrepreneurs.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n81a7e0bca1d.x: These groups get preferential access and an additional 5 per cent subsidy, which is not restricted to women alone.

ncf500cb1c11.s:
Assertion (A): Delayed payment of incentives is unrelated to the MSME problem in Andhra Pradesh.
Reason (R): MSME Samadhaan is associated with delayed-payment grievances.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncf500cb1c11.x: Delayed incentive payments are a recognised MSME grievance, so A is false; R is true, as MSME Samadhaan (with the 45-day rule) deals with delayed payments.

ndcfcc4e1182.s:
Assertion (A): Mega projects in Andhra Pradesh may receive up to 15% investment subsidy.
Reason (R): Large projects may receive up to 12% investment subsidy.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ndcfcc4e1182.x: Both ceilings are correct (Large 12%, Mega 15%, plus 5% extra for women, BC, SC, ST and specially-abled investors), but one does not explain the other.

nc3d5d501125.s: Under IDP (4.0)'s Early Bird scheme, the first 200 projects obtaining Consent for Establishment within 18 months get an investment subsidy of:
nc3d5d501125.x: The first 200 projects with CFE within 18 months get 30%; PLI-sector projects with CFE within 24 months get 40%.

n8808b59d6d1.s: Which of the following pairs under Andhra Pradesh's industrial policy is INCORRECTLY matched?
n8808b59d6d1.x: Textiles is a Sustenance sector, not a Propelling sector; aerospace and blue economy are Propelling and auto is Sustenance.

nd9b75ae2cf9.s: Under the revised definition effective from 1 April 2025, a small enterprise has an investment limit of:
nd9b75ae2cf9.x: A small enterprise now has investment up to Rs 25 crore and turnover up to Rs 100 crore.

nffc1ea751cf.s: IDP (4.0) 2024-29 targets raising manufacturing GVA from Rs 3.4 lakh crore in FY24 to:
nffc1ea751cf.x: The policy targets manufacturing GVA rising from Rs 3.4 lakh crore in FY24 to Rs 7.3 lakh crore.

n7181627c572.s: Andhra Pradesh's Industrial Development Policy (4.0) 2024-29 targets investment of:
n7181627c572.x: IDP (4.0) targets Rs 30 lakh crore investment, US$10 billion FDI and five lakh manufacturing jobs.

n2d66db2f64e.s: Under IDP (4.0), eligible units get reimbursement of what share of net SGST for five years from commercial production?
n2d66db2f64e.x: IDP (4.0) reimburses 100% of net SGST for five years on final products made, sold and registered in AP.

n68f9b9d6da2.s: The AP MSME and Entrepreneur Development Policy (4.0) 2024-29 targets "One Family, One Entrepreneur" by:
n68f9b9d6da2.x: The policy targets One Family, One Entrepreneur by 2030 and investment of Rs 50,000 crore.

n0f6e6a07058.s: Under IDP (4.0), an Ultra Mega unit is one with investment above:
n0f6e6a07058.x: Ultra Mega units involve investment above Rs 5,000 crore and get a tailor-made package; the standard period is four years.

nce39e88dc75.s: The AP Single Desk Portal was originally designed to provide 93 clearances from how many departments within 21 days?
nce39e88dc75.x: The portal was designed for 93 clearances from 19 departments within 21 days.

n5d2d0f88ba3.s: From 1 April 2025, the limits for a medium enterprise are:
o: Investment Rs 125 crore, turnover Rs 500 crore
Investment Rs 50 crore, turnover Rs 250 crore
Investment Rs 100 crore, turnover Rs 400 crore
Investment Rs 25 crore, turnover Rs 100 crore
n5d2d0f88ba3.x: The 2020 medium limits of Rs 50 crore and Rs 250 crore became Rs 125 crore and Rs 500 crore from 1 April 2025.

n718bf6f2767.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB), which takes final decisions on mega projects, is chaired by the:
n718bf6f2767.x: SIPB is chaired by the Chief Minister; the SIPC, chaired by the Chief Secretary, screens proposals.

n727f03784e3.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
n727f03784e3.s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget, the education sector accounted for what share of total spending?
n727f03784e3.x: Education received Rs 35,673 crore, 11.7% of spending, against the all-States average of 14.5%.

n453a430e7e5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) in Andhra Pradesh?
n453a430e7e5.x: Language skills rose from 21% to 47%; the 20% to 50% rise was in mathematics, so the statement reverses the figures.

n89b36989673.s:
Assertion (A): As per SRS 2021-23, Andhra Pradesh's infant mortality rate (19) is lower than India's (25).
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh's total fertility rate (1.5) is lower than India's (1.9).
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n89b36989673.x: Both figures are correct per SRS 2021-23 (U5MR is also 21 vs 29), but a lower fertility rate does not explain a lower infant mortality rate.

nbd226fc259b.s: Which of the following pairs regarding life expectancy (SRS 2021-23) is correctly matched?
o: Male life expectancy, Andhra Pradesh – 70.1 years
Female life expectancy, Andhra Pradesh – 73.3 years
nbd226fc259b.x: Female life expectancy is 73.3 years in AP vs 72.5 in India; male life expectancy is 68.5 years in both.

n8c808cc5d32.s:
Assertion (A): In the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh was among the top 5 States on SDG 3 (Good Health).
Reason (R): SDG 4 (Quality Education) was flagged for accelerated action in Andhra Pradesh.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8c808cc5d32.x: Both are true as per APSES 2024-25, but the education flag does not explain AP's health ranking.

ncb04fca7243.s: The YSR Nethanna Nestham scheme of Andhra Pradesh benefits:
ncb04fca7243.x: YSR Nethanna Nestham benefits handloom weavers; Kanti Velugu concerns eye health and Nadu-Nedu school education.

n7c2c71bafee.s: In Andhra Pradesh's spending, debt service accounted for how many paise of every rupee?
n7c2c71bafee.x: Debt service took 18 paise and welfare 17 paise of every rupee, described as broadly the same level.

nc5c814a5cf6.s: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva provides health cover of how much per family per year?
nc5c814a5cf6.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva covers BPL families and families with income up to Rs 5 lakh, with cover of Rs 25 lakh per family per year.

n5422d90dac6.s: The total fertility rate (TFR) of Andhra Pradesh, well below replacement level, is:
n5422d90dac6.x: AP's TFR is 1.5, well below replacement; its MMR, IMR and TFR are all better than the national goals.

n4515817a834.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the revival of Amaravati as the capital of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The AP High Court upheld Amaravati as the capital in March 2022
The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 amended Section 5 of the 2014 Act
The 2026 amendment made Amaravati the sole capital
The 2026 amendment has retrospective effect from 2 June 2014
n4515817a834.x: The retrospective date of the 2026 amendment is 2 June 2024, not 2 June 2014.

nab5cd560470.s:
Assertion (A): The Amaravati master plan follows a 30-minute-city design for a water-centric city on the Krishna.
Reason (R): The plan provides for about 41% green and blue space.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nab5cd560470.x: A is true, but the plan provides 51% green/blue space, not 41%.

n5024bc3017c.s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region, a NITI Aayog pilot, comprises how many districts?
n5024bc3017c.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region comprises 10 districts, is a NITI Aayog pilot and already has a master plan.

n6adf4db64a1.s: Andhra Pradesh's three-capital proposal was based on the G.N. Rao Committee and a study by:
n6adf4db64a1.x: The proposal rested on the G.N. Rao Committee and a Boston Consulting Group study; the Sarkaria Commission was not its basis.

n7aec5a1e69c.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's three-capital proposal, the judicial seat was to be at:
n7aec5a1e69c.x: Visakhapatnam was the executive seat, Amaravati the legislative seat and Kurnool the judicial seat.

n6b87a3e60a5.s: In the South African model cited for AP's three-capital proposal, the judicial capital is:
n6b87a3e60a5.x: Pretoria is administrative, Cape Town legislative and Bloemfontein judicial.

ndf7d6d3ce2f.s: The Andhra Pradesh High Court upheld Amaravati as the capital in:
ndf7d6d3ce2f.x: The three-capitals plan came in 2020, the High Court upheld Amaravati in March 2022, Amaravati was relaunched in May 2025 and the sole-capital law passed in 2026.

n01e4e130425.s: Under Phase I land pooling in Amaravati, how many returnable plots were allotted?
n01e4e130425.x: Phase I pooled 93.1% of 37,921 acres and allotted 70,550 returnable plots.

n6cbcc3b1c95.shape: one-liner (too few true facts for a NOT question)
n6cbcc3b1c95.s: Over 90% of abuse complaints from Gulf migrant workers of Andhra Pradesh come from those not recruited through:
n6cbcc3b1c95.x: Housemaids must be recruited via OMCAP, and over 90% of abuse complaints come from workers not recruited through it.

nb16ca9bc607.s:
Assertion (A): Skill International in Andhra Pradesh provides German (A1-B2) language training for overseas placement, mainly for nurses.
Reason (R): It signed a Letter of Intent with Germany's FVCC for overseas placement.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nb16ca9bc607.x: A is true, but the Letter of Intent (6 May 2026) was with Japan's FVCC, not a German body.

n2c242de22a7.s: In Andhra Pradesh, DDU-GKY is implemented by:
n2c242de22a7.x: DDU-GKY is implemented by SEEDAP, DAY-NRLM by SERP and DAY-NULM by MEPMA.

nd7e1733ae85.s:
Assertion (A): The women's share of bus passengers in Andhra Pradesh rose from 40% to 65%.
Reason (R): Stree Shakti, from 15 August 2025, provides free bus travel to women and transgender persons.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd7e1733ae85.x: The rise in women's share from 40% to 65% came under Stree Shakti's free bus travel.

nf4499ec1f95.s: Pasupu Kumkuma gave a grant of how much per DWCRA woman?
nf4499ec1f95.x: Pasupu Kumkuma (TDP, 2019) gave Rs 10,000 per DWCRA woman; YSR Aasara reimbursed SHG loans in instalments.

nc302da470e5.s: Under the public distribution system in Andhra Pradesh, AAY households receive:
nc302da470e5.x: AAY beneficiaries get 35 kg per card, while PHH beneficiaries get 5 kg per person.

n0a8c89df9b1.s: In Andhra Pradesh's 2026-27 Budget, the total allocation for BC welfare was:
n0a8c89df9b1.x: BC welfare got Rs 51,021 crore (of which the BC department Rs 23,650.88 crore), SC welfare Rs 20,644 crore and minorities Rs 6,090 crore.

n866cc872abc.s: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project, implemented by SERP, is assisted by:
n866cc872abc.x: The project is World Bank-assisted, implemented by SERP and has five components.

n781379cc719.s: Velugu was merged with DWCRA as:
n781379cc719.x: Velugu (2000) was merged with DWCRA as Indira Kranthi Patham, run by SERP.

n181233425aa.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's dependence on central transfers?
o: About 40% of its revenues came from the Centre in the 2024-25 BE
The share was about 47% in the 2024-25 RE when EAP loans were included
Andhra Pradesh depended less on grants than the average State
CSS constitute about 40% of all central transfers to the State
n181233425aa.x: Andhra Pradesh relies more on grants than the average State, not less.

n36c40832791.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about developmental and non-developmental expenditure?
o: The developmental classification is identical to the revenue-capital classification
Developmental expenditure may be incurred as revenue expenditure
Salaries of teachers can be developmental revenue expenditure
Construction of irrigation dams can be developmental capital expenditure
n36c40832791.x: The developmental/non-developmental division cuts across the revenue/capital division; it is not identical to it.

n0c1887ad68f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's debt and guarantees?
o: Market borrowing was Rs 4,83,093 crore in 2025-26 RE
Small-savings deposits go to the National Small Savings Fund
Guarantees are included in outstanding debt
Guarantees were Rs 1,77,328 crore, or 10% of GSDP, in the 2026-27 Budget
n0c1887ad68f.x: Guarantees are contingent liabilities that lie outside outstanding debt.

ncc414c93aa8.s: Which of the following is NOT a recommendation of the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
o: States' fiscal deficit capped at 3% of GSDP
Union fiscal deficit capped at 3.5% of GDP
Off-budget borrowings to remain outside the budget
ncc414c93aa8.x: The 16th FC recommended bringing off-budget borrowings on budget and discontinuing them.

n9097e803969.s:
Assertion (A): The 16th Finance Commission, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, retained the States' share in the divisible pool at 41%.
Reason (R): Eighteen States had asked for a 50% share for the States.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n9097e803969.x: Both are true, but the 50% demand by 18 States does not explain why the share was kept at 41%.

nfd83195ce8f.s:
Assertion (A): Market borrowings are the largest component of Andhra Pradesh's public debt.
Reason (R): Market borrowings, at Rs 4,83,093 crore in 2025-26 RE, were about 75% of the debt.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nfd83195ce8f.x: At about 75% of the debt, market borrowings are by definition its largest component.

n6aebc662c3e.s: In 2026-27, interest payments and principal repayment together accounted for how many paise of every rupee in Andhra Pradesh?
n6aebc662c3e.x: Interest and principal took 18 paise, level with welfare at 17 paise, and the State continued to run a primary deficit.

nab2da3ad9f0.s: Which of the following is a key indicator of the debt sustainability of a State?
nab2da3ad9f0.x: Debt-GSDP and interest payments to revenue receipts are the key debt-sustainability indicators.

n3dafc27dfa5.s: After GST, sales tax in Andhra Pradesh continues mainly on:
n3dafc27dfa5.x: Sales tax continues mainly on petroleum products and liquor, which remain outside GST; SGST was about 40 per cent in 2025-26 RE.

n8be46cc573b.s: Which of the following is a component of a State's own non-tax revenue?
n8be46cc573b.x: Interest receipts, royalties and user charges are non-tax revenue, which is not raised by taxing the public.

n9da20f39ebf.s: Investments of the Consolidated Sinking Fund are made in:
n9da20f39ebf.x: States contribute to the CSF to amortise liabilities, and it is invested in Government of India securities.

na8ac235d3bf.s: Andhra Pradesh's Socio-Economic Survey, traditionally tabled before the Budget speech, was skipped in the Budget session of:
na8ac235d3bf.x: The Survey was skipped in the 2026 Budget session; its presentation is not a constitutional obligation.

n36004a0a342.s: Andhra Pradesh's interest payments account for about what share of its revenue receipts?
n36004a0a342.x: Interest payments of Rs 37,281 crore are about 16% of revenue receipts; pensions are Rs 23,713 crore.

n631919fac09.s: The 16th Finance Commission fixed the States' share in the divisible pool of Union taxes at:
n631919fac09.x: The 16th FC, like the 15th, fixed the States' share at 41%; the 14th FC had fixed it at 42%.

na043823ab62.s: Since Andhra Pradesh continues to run a primary deficit, its borrowing is used to meet:
na043823ab62.x: With a primary deficit, borrowing also finances current spending, not just past interest.

n94ae23b3d7d.s: In Andhra Pradesh, mica is associated mainly with the:
n94ae23b3d7d.x: Mica occurs in the Nellore belt, limestone in the Kadapa-Kurnool basins and barytes at Mangampet.

n34bb31c074f.s: Guarantees given by the Andhra Pradesh government crystallise as liabilities only when they are:
n34bb31c074f.x: Guarantees are contingent liabilities that crystallise if invoked; they are not part of outstanding debt before that.

n38fbee8d1d8.s: Decisions of the GST Council require a:
n38fbee8d1d8.x: GST Council decisions need a three-fourths majority; GST began on 1 July 2017 under the 101st Amendment Act, 2016.

n2356ff46a46.s: Andhra Pradesh's allocation for education in 2026-27 was:
n2356ff46a46.x: Education got Rs 35,673 crore, 11.7% of spending, against an all-States average of 14.5%.

nca2c9c7ab97.s: Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue, estimated at Rs 1,25,846 crore, was about what share of GSDP?
nca2c9c7ab97.x: Own tax revenue was Rs 1,25,846 crore, about 6.4% of GSDP, up 28%.

n3fb10b84fb1.s: Capital expenditure by a State government mainly reflects its commitment to:
n3fb10b84fb1.x: As per the PYQ key, capex signals commitment to building infrastructure; AP's capex stayed below 15% of total expenditure in 2016-21.

n32e7dc1a8d9.s: In the 2024-25 Revised Estimates, the largest component of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue was:
n32e7dc1a8d9.x: SGST led at 38%, followed by State excise (22%), sales tax (~19%), stamps and registration (~10%) and motor vehicles tax (~5%).

n639ccee41c1.s: In the 2024-25 RE, the components of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts ranked from highest to lowest share are:
o: Own Non-Tax, Own Tax, Central Transfers
Central Transfers, Own Tax, Own Non-Tax
Own Tax, Own Non-Tax, Central Transfers
Own Tax, Central Transfers, Own Non-Tax
n639ccee41c1.x: Own Tax ranked first, then Central Transfers, with Own Non-Tax the smallest.

nc7644164086.s: In the 2024-25 RE, own non-tax revenue formed about what share of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts?
nc7644164086.x: Own non-tax revenue (Rs 7,018 crore) was only about 4%, while own tax was about half and central transfers about 45-47%.

nb97ca3f2d4b.s: Andhra Pradesh's capital outlay rose from Rs 7,244 crore in 2022-23 to ____ in 2023-24.
nb97ca3f2d4b.x: Capital outlay more than tripled to Rs 23,331 crore in 2023-24 and increased further thereafter.

ncf0b535caca.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
ncf0b535caca.s: Special Category and Himalayan States ordinarily follow which Centre-State sharing pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
ncf0b535caca.x: CSS ordinarily follow 90:10 for Special Category and Himalayan States and 60:40 for general States.

ncbfa20d9e1c.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: all original statements true)
ncbfa20d9e1c.s: Which Article of the Constitution is associated with discretionary grants to States?
ncbfa20d9e1c.x: Article 282 concerns discretionary grants; Article 275 provides statutory grants and Article 280(3)(bb),(c) relates to local bodies.

n2f7836a0799.s:
Assertion (A): Revenue-deficit grants to States are given under Article 275.
Reason (R): Article 275 provides statutory grants to States.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n2f7836a0799.x: Article 275 provides statutory grants, which include revenue-deficit, local-body and disaster-related grants; Article 282 covers discretionary grants.

nea7cb94f1fc.s: In lieu of Special Category Status, Andhra Pradesh was provided a Special Assistance Measure of:
nea7cb94f1fc.x: SCS was not granted; instead a Special Assistance Measure of Rs 24,350 crore was provided.

n150b331397e.s: The Centre is to fund Polavaram as a national project; an older cited estimate placed its cost at:
n150b331397e.x: An older cited estimate put Polavaram's cost at Rs 55,548 crore, funded by the Centre, though releases have been delayed.
